comments.value: We're interested in this, but there are a few design issues to figure out. Likewise, it isn't a super high priority, since the information is just a click away as it is. We'll look into it, though!

OMG this is really needed because in old vrchat from 2017-2021 in old vrchat we are able to see how many people was in some public world but in this new vrchat we only see 1 or 0 players and when we go there there are many users in there
tbh i don't see this as missing vrchat feature
because this is an error that vrchat need to fix

I honestly don't see the reason why someone even would want to see the total player count in the world menu on any instance of that world unless that user is the world creator.

What good does it to me to know how many players are in private instances of that world when I can only join on public instances?
This really should be the default. Every time I want to hang out in public I always revert back to the same 3 worlds because it takes forever to check every single world for a public playercount.

@{632a1f5ab98aa644af84dab3|full_name}: easy fix: remove the count for members displaying on world images add a world icon under the world itself instead of player icon when viewing the world itself like the icon can display how many worlds are viewable as public spaces because players dont really need to be looking at private spaces when trying to search for public spaces hence why there private in the first place.

when viewing the instances that are open it should display the player count in real time filter each instance name up and down every 10 seconds hence to allow the player to choose the instance they want to join before the instance updates.

and then group instances should have there name displayed instead of the instance saying its a group instance. on the right.
Yes!  I was going to post this.  Like, i really don't care how many people are in  private.  They are inaccessible.   I only need the public numbers.

I can't +1 enough, it would do so much to help revive public worlds!!! The information isn't just 1 click away because we're checking entire lists of worlds.

For the design issue, an easy first step might be to change this on the website's Favorite Worlds page. Add a new field for Public Users In-World.

Otherwise, I don't care about private player count and even if it is useful as  proxy for popularity, I'd choose public player count any day as the more useful stat.

comments.value: @{627e94e69bf04e1ede28a21b|full_name} we should probably clean up what is still actively tracked, interested, ect. Alot of these are no longer tracked, no longer implemented or are reworked into a VRC+ shop item or in general are no longer supported. Kinda hard to tell whats being worked on and whats scrapped

I like browsing new worlds. They tend to have between zero and ten users in them. When browsing worlds, you see how many people are currently in a world. This is useful because I prefer joining instances with people. Unfortunately, the player number includes people in private instances. Most new worlds *only* have private instances. This is annoying because I end up clicking on a world thinking that it has players, only to see that I can't join any instances because they are private. Then I go back to the world menu and click on the next world and it happens again and so on. The player count for private instances is useless.

It would be better if the player count was for public instances only. Or if there was a setting to change this. Or if there were separate private and public player counts. This way I would immediately see which worlds I should join.

details: I spent too much time in the menu clicking on worlds just to figure out that they are all empty. It would be nice end very helpful to know which worlds have people that I can join and meet rather than wasting my time in the menu, getting bored and going back to The Great Pug.
title: [1236] Show the public player count on worlds before clicking on them
